messages:
ashley_pm: Heads-up — dropping the draft PRD for the unified API spec for chat/completions + embeddings + rerank. Need quick triage on scope tradeoffs before we commit to the roadmap sprint. Main asks: customer deterministic embeddings, lower-cost rerank option, and clear launch gates for latencies and quality.

omar_eng: skimmed it. big flag: rerank QPS will spike and current runtime needs batching changes. we can do a light batching mode but it increases p95 for single requests. tradeoff: throughput vs single-request latency.

sophia_ml: from eval POV we need acceptance criteria per endpoint. suggested thresholds: embeddings cosine recall (MAP@10) >= 0.82 on vendor eval set; chat generation BLEU/ROUGE not enough — require human eval pass-rate >= 90% on 100-case prompt suite. also define regression checks for quantized models.

leo_prod_ops: rollout gating: require canary traffic for 48h, <1.5% error rate, p99 latency delta <20% vs current baseline. add automatic rollback hook if error surge. also need monitoring dashboards and alert runbook.

maria_sales: to be explicit — BigRetail asked for deterministic embeddings (payload-level seed+model) and an SLA for similarity queries. they'll only go Dedicated if we can guarantee stable vector outputs across restarts.

ashley_pm: noted. two immediate decisions to propose: 1) MVP scope: support deterministic embeddings + simple rerank (non-streaming) + chat completions without changing existing client API shapes. 2) Defer streaming rerank + realtime low-latency optimized path to post-launch v2. agree/disagree?

omar_eng: agree to MVP but need to include a config knob for `batching_mode: "low_latency" | "high_throughput"` and default to low_latency for host-api. snippet for runtime config:```json
{
  "model": "redwood-embed-1",
  "batching_mode": "low_latency",
  "max_batch_ms": 8
}
```
won't break API but requires runtime flags and rollout plan.

sophia_ml: acceptance criteria for deterministic embeddings: 1) bit-stable outputs for same model+config across two cold restarts, 2) cosine similarity variance < 1e-6 across 1000 samples, 3) unit tests that check a small canonical set. add these to PRD.

leo_prod_ops: ops checklist: infra capacity for rerank (estimate +50% of current embeddings QPS), dedicated canary pool, synthetic load script, dashboards (per-route cost/token, per-route p95/p99). I can own the runbook.

maria_sales: also note contract asks: export logs for similarity queries + timestamped model version in responses. helps audits.

ashley_pm: good. open questions: do we expose `deterministic=true` param on embeddings endpoint or make it per-model config? my bias: endpoint param so customers can opt-in without model churn. thoughts?

omar_eng: param is easiest for deployment but means we need two code paths in runtime (deterministic vs fast stochastic). perf cost for deterministic path (no fused rng) ~3-5% per token. acceptable?

sophia_ml: agree with param. we'll gate determinism behind quantization-friendly path: document known failure modes (drop in recall for certain quantized kernels). add acceptance tests for those edge cases.

leo_prod_ops: seconding param approach. add telemetry `deterministic_enabled: true/false` to logs.

maria_sales: customer ok with opt-in param as long as it's documented and included in SLA.

ashley_pm: action items: 1) omar: add runtime config PR + `batching_mode` flag (owner: @omar_eng) — due in 3d. 2) sophia: add acceptance criteria section with eval suites & regression tests (owner: @sophia_ml) — due in 2d. 3) leo: operations runbook & dashboards (owner: @leo_prod_ops) — due in 5d. 4) add example API snippet to PRD showing `deterministic=true` for embeddings and `rerank_mode: "batch"` default.

ci-bot: New PR created: redwood/api-specs#412 by omar_eng — runtime flags + batching_mode. CI: build queued.

omar_eng: i'll start the PR today. flagging needs from eng-ml: a small canary fleet for the deterministic path to validate perf.

sophia_ml: i'll start building the 100-case human eval suite and a 1k sample auto suite for embeddings. posting eval script after lunch.

ashley_pm: thanks all — plan to reconvene in 48 hours for final scope lock. if anyone has hard objections to the MVP list, call it out now. :thumbsup:
